_comment: Measured ROM profiles. Only entries with "measured": true may override the built-in defaults in RomDetection, so adding a device we have read off a phone is a data edit here, not a code change. Never add a profile whose ids were guessed - use "measured": false and leave it in code until a device confirms it.

profiles.label: OxygenOS / OnePlus
profiles.notes: measured on OxygenOS 16 (CPH2747): system_icons -> LinearLayout, battery 83x61 px

profiles.label: HyperOS / MIUI
profiles.notes: measured on HyperOS 3 (24129PN74G, Android 17): system_icons -> MiuiStatusBatteryContainer holding statusIcons + battery; system_icon_area is the parent
